title: Origins: Whimsy Classes

body:
# Whimsy Classes A pack of origins classes (that function with or without the original Origins: Classes addon ;)) inspired mostly by silly little activities that aren't super vital to the game, but are simply part of the whimsy of a little world where you can do whatever you want. ## **Camper** *a class based around basic exploration survival* + Smoke Signal: Your firestarting abilities, with a stick in each hand, allow you to create a smoke signal. + Marshmallows: While not a great food source, you can eat marshmallows quickly or roast them by a campfire for a bit of extra saturation.
★ Marshmallows and Roasted Marshmallows are just sugar, only you can eat them + Pick Up And Go: You can pick up campfires intact.
(Hidden) + Ghost Stories: Ghost particles occasionally appear around you when you are near a campfire beneath the night sky.
## **Packster** *a class made for people who like having a lot of dogs* + Instant Buds: You only require one bone to tame any dog. + Scraps: Your dogs can heal from scraps of any meat you eat. ## **Musician** *a class made for those who like collecting music discs* + Starting Disc: You begin with one random music disc. + Collector's Luck: Creepers have a very small chance to drop a disc when killed by you. + Healing Song: When you play music, everything nearby will gain slight regeneration for a few seconds. ## **Diver** *a class made for those who have a bit of a drowning issue* + Hold Your Breath: Your air bubbles last a bit longer. + Extra Air: You can consume up to 10 water or air bottles to replenish some extra breath. Fully recover your breath to use them again.
★ The bottle type depends on what you breathe ## Snowshoe *a class made for those who like the colder biomes* + Snow Shoes: You spawn with a pair of warm leather boots already equipped for whatever snowy terrain you may encounter. + Steady Step: You can walk across ice without slipping, however you can instead slide significantly faster than normal if wearing iron boots. + Careful Hands: Never be unprepared in the event of a snowball fight, as you can obtain them from snow blocks without need for a shovel
(Hidden) Do You Wanna Build A Snowman?: Strays have a small chance to drop pumpkin seeds, similar to how a zombie may drop a potato.
